error: Could not read the trend map.
rampAria: Colour scale from −{{edge}} (falling) to +{{edge}} (rising) {{unit}} per decade

full.general: Strong colour: the change holds up in the statistical tests
full.expert: Full colour: significant after FDR correction

faded.general: Faded: no clear change, or only weak evidence
faded.expert: Faded: not significant, or significant only before correction

key.empty: No colour: no data, or not analysed

fadeNote: Colours also fade where the change is close to zero, so the surface shows through.
summary: {{share}} of the analysed area shows a change that holds up in the tests ({{first}} to {{last}}).
periodLine: Period {{first}} to {{last}} ({{count}} months). Grid {{lat}} × {{lon}}. Significant after FDR correction: {{fdr}} of the analysed area ({{raw}} before correction).
method: Method: linear trend of monthly anomalies in each grid cell; t-test adjusted for lag-1 autocorrelation; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the map at α = {{alpha}}. The colour range is ± the {{quantile}}th percentile of the absolute cell trends; values beyond it take the end colours.

warning.general: Faded does not mean no change. A change of sensor or data product can also create a false trend.
warning.expert: Not significant does not mean no change. Trends are computed on a ~1° grid; sensor or product changes can cause artificial trends.
